svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Two directories in hybrid identity
svg.desc: Active Directory Domain Services handles on-premises Windows identity, while Microsoft Entra ID handles cloud identity and token-based cloud application sign-in. Connect Sync or Cloud Sync synchronises users and groups between them.
